latest.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
latest.description: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

latest.title: A company that vouches for websites had secret keys so weak that 8 of them were cracked
